name: Sokoto
registryBasis: The Sokoto State Ministry of Lands & Survey lists SOGIS within the state land-administration portfolio, and the official Sokoto budget includes reproduction of Sokoto cadastral maps and mapping of Sokoto township. The state ministry’s SOGIS page and the linked SOGIS agency landing are informational; no public parcel-vector route or schema was found.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The state agency and Sokoto-township cadastral mapping are documented, but the public SOGIS landing page exposes no safe anonymous parcel-vector service/schema. The application route was not opened. Runtime remains disabled.

officialSources.observation: Official Sokoto State Ministry of Lands & Survey page labels SOGIS as a ministry component. Direct anonymous HTTPS GET returned 200; the static page uses generic WordPress/Elementor scripts and links to informational pages and an application route, with no public parcel service schema.

Agency landing page linked from the state ministry. Direct anonymous HTTPS GET returned 200 and identifies the Sokoto State Geographic Information System Agency. Public landing/navigation contains no parcel-vector schema; a menu link labelled Apply was not opened.

Official state budget search result identifies a Surveyor General project to reproduce Sokoto cadastral maps and map Sokoto township; cited as city-bound mapping-program evidence, not a live parcel data source.
